links.comparator_used: Base Claude (same model without RAG integration, relying on training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Guideline concordance of periprocedural anticoagulation recommendations (withholding, withholding/reinitiation timeframes, INR thresholds), scored 0-2 by a human assessor
links.effect: RAG integration significantly improved Claude's performance across all categories, except platelet thresholds; RAG Claude achieved the highest overall guideline concordance (1.51/2). Base Claude numbers not given in the abstract.
links.quote: RAG integration significantly improved Claude's performance across all categories, except platelet thresholds.
